selection.connectConnector: Connect the {{pins}}-pin connector from the tractor to the device

measurement.note: Each pin is measured separately. Signal lines are evaluated using PULSE and voltage together.

validation.pin10Body: Confirm whether the lining-wear warning function exists in this vehicle / trailer system. Do not start this test if the function is not present. If it is present, confirm and continue.
validation.pin10Check: The vehicle has a lining-wear function.
validation.pin11Body: Confirm that the relevant brake-system function is actually used in this vehicle / trailer system. Do not start this test if the function is not present. If it is present, confirm and continue.
validation.pin11Check: The vehicle has the relevant brake-system function.
validation.pin12Body: Confirm that the vehicle / trailer has an axle-lift function. Verify that air pressure is suitable and active. Do not start the operation if the pneumatic system or working conditions are unsuitable.
validation.pin12Warning: Do not operate if air pressure is not suitable.
validation.pin12Check: The axle-lift function is present and air pressure is suitable.
validation.genericWarning: Measurement must not start before the function is confirmed.
validation.footer: When CONFIRM AND START is selected, the relevant pin toggle is enabled automatically and measurement starts. If FUNCTION NOT PRESENT is selected, the row remains disabled and is excluded from the report.
